2608.09286.title: VeinCast: Physics-Guided Dynamic Field Graphs with Graph-Conditioned Fusion for Global Medium-Range Weather Forecasting
2608.09286.paper_summary: Global medium-range weather forecasting requires modeling structured yet state-dependent interactions among heterogeneous atmospheric fields. Existing data-driven models largely learn these interactions implicitly, whereas equation-level physical constraints may inherit approximation and model-form biases. We present VeinCast, a physics-guided dynamic field graph and graph-conditioned fusion framework that jointly forecasts 69 surface and upper-air fields. Within each local window, its Physics-Guided Dynamic Field Graph combines predefined atmospheric relations with state-dependent Top-K residual edges and adapts Earth-window attention using the resulting graph context. Graph-Conditioned Latent Fusion further employs graph context and source-node centrality to guide field-to-latent aggregation, while bounded feedback preserves field-specific information. On the $1.5^\circ$ ERA5 benchmark, VeinCast demonstrates competitive forecasting performance across all 69 meteorological fields at lead times of up to 14 days, compared with representative global weather forecasting models including FuXi, Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, FengWu, and ARROW. Ablations confirm that the two modules provide complementary gains, demonstrating the effectiveness of relational-level physical guidance for data-driven weather forecasting.
2608.09286.paper_summary_zh: 全球中程天氣預報需要對異質大氣場之間的結構化但狀態依賴的互動進行建模。現有的數據驅動模型在很大程度上是隱式學習這些互動，而方程級的物理約束可能會繼承近似和模型形式的偏差。我們提出了VeinCast，一個物理引導的動態場圖和圖條件融合框架，該框架共同預測69個地面和高空場。在每個局部窗口中，其物理引導動態場圖將預定義的大氣關係與狀態依賴的Top-K殘差邊結合，並使用生成的圖上下文調整地球窗口注意力。圖條件潛在融合進一步利用圖上下文和源節點中心性來指導場到潛在的聚合，而有界反饋則保留場特定的信息。在$1.5^\circ$ ERA5基準上，VeinCast在預測性能上表現出與FuXi、Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、FengWu和ARROW等代表性全球天氣預報模型的競爭力，涵蓋所有69個氣象場，預測時間長達14天。消融實驗確認這兩個模塊提供了互補的增益，證明了關係級物理指導對數據驅動天氣預報的有效性。
